culprit_citations.quoted_text: Funded debt row shows First lien with SOFR reference, 6.25% spread, and 11.64% interest rate.
Unfunded debt row shows First lien - Undrawn with dash reference, dash spread, and dash interest rate.
Unfunded Australia row shows First lien - Undrawn with dash reference, dash spread, and dash interest rate.

rationale: The weak dl_rate_fill flag reports a 60.7 fill metric with missing rates across direct-lending units, but the raw SOI separates funded debt from unfunded debt. Funded first-lien rows disclose reference, spread, and interest-rate values, while the unfunded/undrawn rows disclose dashes in those same rate columns. The stored blank interest_rate values on undrawn/unfunded rows therefore match the source; the rule is over-scoping unfunded commitments rather than identifying an extraction defect.
